summary: Validated Commerce Center V1 Deepen features. Backend API returns analytics_cards (4), performance_rankings (3), and program_schedule (5) arrays correctly. Frontend renders all new sections: Commerce Analytics with 4 metric cards, Programmplanung with scheduled/live items and CTAs, Performance Board with ranking cards. Category tabs and Flash Sale buy CTAs work without crashes. Event tracking endpoint accepts page_view, cta_click, and category_filter events.
critical_code_review_comments: Commerce Center overview endpoint correctly builds analytics_cards, performance_rankings, and program_schedule arrays from live data.
Event tracking stores events with proper metadata (event_type, target_type, target_id, source, client_ip, user_agent).
Frontend correctly renders all new sections with proper data-testid attributes for testing.
Category tabs trigger trackEvent('category_filter', 'category', tab.key) on click as expected.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created - used existing seeded data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Commerce Center V1 Deepen validated. New sections: Commerce Analytics (4 cards: revenue_24h, cta_clicks_24h, conversion_rate, live_viewers_now), Programmplanung (schedule list with live/scheduled items), Performance Board (ranking cards). Event tracking endpoint /api/commerce-center/events accepts page_view, cta_click, category_filter events. All data-testids working: commerce-center-analytics-*, commerce-program-schedule-list, commerce-program-item-*, commerce-performance-list, commerce-performance-item-*.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - Feature validation, not bug fix
